rank_portability.definition: Within each family, average-rank raw memory-loss rho scaled to [0,1], predicted in a held-out family by the same trait's mean rank in all other families; baseline=0.5.

global_trait_spectrum.interpretation: Average trait ordering is similar across tree treatments even though it has little robust predictive value for the ordering inside an unseen family.

measurement_aware_reordering.model: latent rho = intercept + family effect + trait effect + system-specific effect; sampling variance modeled separately
measurement_aware_reordering.derivation: For two random traits, the within-family contrast cancels the family effect. Across two random families, contrast correlation r=sigma2_trait/(sigma2_trait+sigma2_system). Under the Gaussian crossed model, P(order reverses)=acos(r)/pi.

interpretation: BIEN contains a weak aggregate trait-level spectrum, but relative conservative-to-labile ordering is extensively re-ranked among families. The S3 rank tendency is stable to leave-one-trait and leave-one-family omission but is not robust to the mandatory prune-only tree sensitivity. Measurement-aware variance components imply frequent latent rank reversals even after sampling error is separated. The strongest current claim is therefore weak common spectrum plus strong lineage-specific re-ranking, pending the pre-frozen AusTraits replication.
hard_nonclaims: Do not claim zero trait-level structure.
Do not call the S3 rank-portability tendency robust across tree treatments.
Do not equate phylogenetic signal with evolutionary rate.
Do not call system-specific heterogeneity a mechanistically identified family-by-trait interaction.
Do not treat the BIEN rank analysis as prospective evidence.
